dog.description_text:
A volunteer writes:
Handsome Mylo is with us as his family moved to a place not allowing cats. He would be a friendly pet but nothing more was revealed about him. The stately ginger(he weights about twenty pounds)looks like a very gentle and sweet kitty laying in the middle of a dog crate and looking at me with big astonished eyes that he closes as I speak to him. He leans into pets and even after lots of encouraging words comes to sit next to me. Mylo is quite a likable cat who would be apparently healthy(he needs to loose some weight, though), is already neutered , had a perfect behavior evaluation and could go home ...today, with you! Mylo is a must to meet, enjoy and mostly bring home. He is waiting for you at the Manhattan Care Center!
dog.name: Mylo
